metas.name: The Goat Life
metas.description: Indian migrant worker Najeeb Muhammad goes to Saudi Arabia to earn money. However, in a twist of fate, he finds himself living a slave-like existence, herding goats in the middle of the desert.

metas.name: Manjummel Boys
metas.description: A carefree vacation turns into a desperate race against time when a group of lifelong friends must unite to save one of their own from a notoriously perilous, uncharted abyss deep within the Guna Caves.

metas.name: Cameo
metas.description: Armed with high hopes and small wallets, three youngsters set out to make their dream film. But when an actor with a flair for drama joins the team, their journey quickly spirals into mayhem.

metas.name: A.R.M - Ajayante Randam Moshanam
metas.description: Set in the Northern Kerala in 1900, 1950 and 1990, Three generations of heroes Maniyan, Kunjikelu and Ajayan, try to protect the most important treasure of the Land.

metas.name: Kishkindha Kaandam
metas.description: Strange events unfold in a monkey-inhabited village, driving a newlywed couple and forest officials to embark on a mission to uncover the root of the unusual disturbances.

metas.name: Raktha Sakshikal Zindabad
metas.description: Raktha Sakshikal Zindabad is a 1998 Malayalam film directed by Venu Nagavalli. The film stars Mohanlal, Suresh Gopi, Suganya and Murali in lead roles.

metas.name: Pulimurugan
metas.description: Murugan, with his tools and expertise, protects Puliyoor's villagers from deadly tiger attacks. However, Daddy, an illegal drugs dealer, takes advantage of Murugan's innocence and wrongly frames him.

metas.name: Valatty
metas.description: Tomy and Amalu are forced to elope when she gets pregnant, against their owners' wishes. As they leave home, they form a friendship with Kari after they are adopted by his owner. But then an agent of an animal testing center captures Amalu. Tomy and Kari must now find and rescue Amalu.

metas.name: My Dear Kuttichathan
metas.description: The story revolves around a mystical indigenous goblin called "Kuttichathan" who is under the spell of an evil sorcerer; however, it gets released by three children and then befriends them.

metas.name: Rock
metas.description: Rock follows the mysterious disappearance of a senior geologist from India's Antarctic mission during the COVID pandemic. As authorities scramble to trace her, she slips beyond their reach. Drifting through shifting realms, her journey intertwines with ancient lore of the Earth's origins, dissolving the boundaries between science and myth, presence and eternity.

metas.name: Honey Bee 2: Celebrations
metas.description: Sebastian and Angela are all set to get married until their difference of opinions and cultural conflicts between the families threaten their union.
A disaster film set during the 2018 Kerala Floods where people from all walks of life faced catastrophic consequences and put in collective efforts to survive the calamity.

metas.name: CIA: Comrade In America
metas.description: A young Aji Mathew is a communist who goes the whole nine yards for the ideologies he believes in. When the girl he loves leaves to the US out of the blue and her parents fix her wedding, Aji is left with just a fortnight to reach the country albeit with no passport or visa. How far he is willing to go for love forms the plot.

metas.name: Malik
metas.description: A past ridden with crime, death and pain is recounted to Freddy, a juvenile criminal, who has been assigned to eliminate his estranged uncle Sulaiman, an aging patriarch, while behind bars.

metas.name: Neelakasham Pachakadal Chuvanna Bhoomi
metas.description: Kasi and Suni are close friends who studied together in an engineering college. Assi, who comes to Kerala to study engineering under the North East quota falls in love with Kasi. Certain incidents that follow set Kasi and Suni on a road trip to Nagaland on two motorcycles. The incidents that happen during this road adventure forms the film.

metas.name: Aanandam
metas.description: A group of students visit Goa and Hampi while on their college trip. Their experiences during their journey help them understand the intricacies of love and friendship.

metas.name: Antony
metas.description: Antony is a ruthless gangster in a town and has a close-knit group, which includes Ann Maria, a college student trained in MMA. Maria and Antony soon get into trouble due to unforeseen circumstances and they set out to solve the issues in violent ways

metas.name: Yoddha
metas.description: Fate brings a young man from rural Kerala to be the protector of a young Lama in Nepal, who is being chased by a dangerous cult.

metas.name: Lakshyam
metas.description: Vimal Kumar, a murder convict and Mustafa, a petty thief escape the clutches of police when the vehicle transporting them to jail meets with an accident. The duo, who get trapped in a forest, gradually get talking and discover more about each other and the way forward. What's awaiting them… handcuffs or a good future?

metas.name: Allauddinum Albhutha Vilakkum
metas.description: A rendering of the classic Arabian tale of Aladdin and his magic lamp.

metas.name: North 24 Kaatham
metas.description: Harikrishnan is a geeky software professional who suffers from an obsessive compulsive disorder. A harthal day sees him travelling to Trivandrum for a conference, and in the midst of the night, he ends up at Paravur railway station with two strangers - Gopalan  a veteran politician and Narayani a social worker - for company.

metas.name: Bamboo Boys
metas.description: Four members of a tribe come to a city to find a doctor when their chief's wife falls ill. Being in a town for the first time, everything is new for them and they end up creating more trouble.

metas.name: Poyyamozhi
metas.description: Jayson is a runaway who is guided through the woods by an older man named Chachan.  However, the dynamic between them changes from a guide and a traveller to a hunter and his prey. The story takes a dark turn when Jayson discovers Chachan's true, vengeful intentions, leading to a shocking confrontation.

metas.name: Kadamattathachan
metas.description: Kadamattathachan is a biopic of a priest named Kadamattath Kathanar, who believed to have magical powers. He was a priest and once sent to forest and learn magical tricks from a wild tribe and promise to stay with them.

metas.name: Guru
metas.description: A few political goons, disguised as Muslims, cause trouble at the temple and kill Raghuraman's family. Later, Raghuraman joins an extremist group and decides to avenge his family's death.

metas.name: Manu Uncle
metas.description: A group of children witness the robbery of a sword from a museum. However, they, along with Manu, set out to catch the culprits and also discover a shocking truth.

metas.name: Jamnapyari
metas.description: Vasoottan an auto driver by profession, who is very good at heart and meanwhile he is an impetuous person. Once a MBA student happens to travel his auto with some hidden purposes.

metas.name: Moonnam Mura
metas.description: A group of high-ranking political officials are on a trip when their bus is hijacked by a group of terrorists headed by Charles (Lalu Alex). They demand the release of their old colleagues languishing in prison in exchange for safe release of the politicians. An ex-cop is hired to free the officials from the group of terrorists.

metas.name: Third World Boys
metas.description: Seven friends set off on an impromptu trip over a weekend to a hill station and experience a number of fun-filled adventures.

metas.name: Kerala Kesari
metas.description: The king of Maninagaram  is cheated, dethroned and banished from the country by Regent Chandra Varma. The royal priest and army officer Prathapan lend support all the treacherous plans of the Regent. When the noble army chief Rajendran voices his protest against the Regent and the priest, he is imprisoned.

metas.name: The Guard
metas.description: The Guard is the world's first film with a single actor in the cast. Released in December 2001, the Indian Malayalam feature film has Kalabhavan Mani, the only actor on screen, playing the role of a forest guard in a lonely, isolated dense forest.

metas.name: Koothara
metas.description: Three engineering students whose life takes a twist after meeting a mysterious man who teaches them the real meaning of life.

metas.name: Ayal Jeevichirippundu
metas.description: John Mathew (Vijay Babu) is a booker prize winning novelist who is on vacation in Goa. Struggling with figuring out a theme for his next book; he meets a fisherman Murukan (Manikandan) who hails from Kerala. The two bond well and join together in their journey.
